doors.note: The door the organization page's own bundle calls (organization-listing/3cf0919a/js/bundle.js: fetch(apiUrl + "/organization-listing/" + sellerShortName + "/upcoming")). HTTP 200, application/vnd.api+json, 31 bytes: an empty listings array and hasMore false — the site's own statement that nothing is on sale.

The /past twin: five listings, every one already over on the recon date — Goldilocks and the Bears (2025-05-17), GLOW (2025-11-21), BEAR PRIDE DRAG TRIVIA BRUNCH and BEAR PRIDE 2026 (2026-06-07), GLOW! The Sequel (2026-07-31), all at The Lumberyard Bar, Seattle. Row shape: listing_title, event_start/event_end (local wall clock), venue_name, venue_city, image (protocol-relative), min_price, listing_slug. Agrees with the empty upcoming door: the organizer's whole catalogue is in the past.
The human page: a 10 KB JavaScript shell (<div id="listing">, AppWrapper config with apiUrl https://events.ticketleap.com/api). No events in the HTML.
The calendar view's range door answered {"errors":[{"status":500}]} for this query shape — not retried, not relied on.

recon.notes: Organizer southseattlebearsocial on TicketLeap; promoter registry entry "South Seattle Bear Social" (bearAffinity always). Parties run a few times a year, so an empty upcoming list is the normal state between them.

coverage.basis: Two doors agree nothing is upcoming on 2026-09-20: the upcoming listing door returns an empty array with hasMore false, and the past door's five listings (hasMore false) are all dated before the recon date, the latest 2026-07-31. Past listings are counted (5), not enumerated.
